note: Grand River access south of Gallatin, where a half-mile gravel road runs from the uplands down to the river flood plain. The primitive camping area is at the gravel parking lot near the entrance off 248th Street, well back from the river. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard; map (01/08) one 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol at the entrance parking lot; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map'. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual + 2027 permit. Pin is in woods 34 m NW of the lot - move onto lot 1357. Not waterfront kept (river ~600 m E). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map.' 'Motor vehicles are restricted to graveled roadways and parking areas.' Map (01/08): one 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol beside the west 'Parking Lot' at the 248th St. entrance (GIS 27 point 106; GIS 26 lot 1357, 34 m). Imagery: lot 1357 is an open gravel pad ~30 x 20 m on the gravel access road with a mowed apron on its west side - a 23-ft rig fits. Designated point at a lot - stays.
PIN: stored 39.89288,-93.93224 = GIS 106, in the woods 34 m NW of the lot. Move to lot 1357: 39.89266,-93.93195.
CLUSTERS: one camping area (the second lot, 1358, is the river-end lot with no camping symbol); near.py nothing else within 3 km.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the camping lot is on the upland ~600 m west of the Grand River.

FEES FROM MARCH 2027 (applies to every MDC area entry and the state:missouri-conservation-areas policy row): MDC release https://mdc.mo.gov/node/307038 ('Campers will need permits to camp on MDC areas starting in March'): 'The Missouri Conservation Commission gave final approval at its Oct. 23 open meeting ... to regulation changes ... that would require campers to purchase a permit to camp on MDC areas starting in March 2027'; 'purchase a permit for $5 for up to five days of camping on conservation areas for up to 10 people'; 'Each person will be limited to three consecutive camping permits and six camping permits annually'; 'available for purchase beginning in March online, at a permit vendor, or over the phone'. The camping page still says 'All camping on conservation areas is free' (true until then), so nightly_low/high 0 written as today's value with the 2027 permit in fees.note; the policy row's fees and booking note need the same update.
